blind.description: A stylized wooden treatment table or massage bench. It features a sturdy warm-brown timber frame with four square corner legs joined by lower stretchers, a lower shelf holding a rounded light-colored basin/bowl underneath, a full-length cream-colored padded mattress with an elevated headrest at one end, and a folded olive-green towel or drape laid across the foot end. Surfaces are solid, clean, and styled with smooth game-ready textures without cracks or floating elements.
blind.from_above: An elongated rectangle displaying the cream fabric mattress running vertically, with a raised headrest cushion at the top, a rectangular green cloth across the bottom edge, and small wooden frame corners protruding at the perimeter.
blind.height_vs_figure: About hip height (under half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure, roughly 2.5 ft tall), about 6.5 ft long, and roughly 2.5 ft wide.
